headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by TCS and HCLTech.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue with a 24% operating margin, the highest in the sector. HCLTech and Tech Mahindra also posted double‑digit YoY revenue growth, supported by AI‑related deals. Wipro grew revenue 9% YoY but saw a slight profit decline. Several peers (Infosys, LTM, OFSS, Persistent, Coforge, Mphasis) have not released results yet, keeping the full picture incomplete.

themes.title: AI as a growth driver
themes.detail: AI‑related sales and revenue contributions are highlighted by TCS, HCLTech and Wipro, indicating early momentum from AI investments.

themes.title: Margin pressure at mid‑tier players
themes.detail: Mid‑tier firms such as Persistent and Coforge show lower operating margins and mixed profit trends.

leaders.why: Largest revenue and strong 24% operating margin.
Double‑digit profit growth and AI‑driven revenue boost.

laggards.why: Revenue growth modest and net profit fell YoY.
Results not yet released, limiting visibility.
